objective: Test whether a composition-level decision improves a sparse/dense four-glyph wordmark BEFORE any handcrafted glyph or eave motif.

proposals.name: same-size horizontal
proposals.layout: single row 4 glyphs evenly spaced; unmodified Noto Serif glyphs

proposals.name: paired horizontal
proposals.layout: two word groups 巷口 and 有风, clear larger gap between groups and optical resizing precommitted from R28: 巷.96 口1.13 有1.02 风1.00

proposals.name: two-line square
proposals.layout: 巷口 on first line, 有风 second line, correct row-major reading, balanced negative space and optical scaling; no geometric glyph edits

control: All three show identical existing font glyph silhouettes; no claim of original lettering. No style strokes, no image generation or Figma.
decision_metric: Assess full-outline visual weight and phrase rhythm at equal canvas AND small size. Only propose one native typographic stroke change after a composition demonstrably better than A. Aesthetics remain human pending.
rejection: If B/C are just rearranged typography without sufficient original identity or small-size recognition risk, stop before Figma and disclose insufficient concept.
existing_failures: R25/R26 original paths and R27 26 contours not aesthetically good; R28 font-only reference is not original artwork.
source: Liang Zhijian 海棠未雨 authored stages already checked in R28, no images reused.
